name: delivery_sdk
_comment_app_assets: Home SDKs ship the splash/login background images (base_sdk's splash_page and auth_sdk's login_page reference assets/images/splash*.png). Each home SDK provides its own copies so every composed app can brand them independently; app_assets gets them into the host pubspec's sdk-app-assets block so they are actually bundled. If base_sdk also installed identical files first, the file copy is skipped (already-present guard) and only the pubspec declaration matters. marker.png and empty-box.json are custodianship copies from paas_driver develop (legacy upstream-era driver assets evicted from base_sdk). my_location.png and balance.svg are custodianship copies from paas_driver main (referenced by the courier home/profile pages via the asset_keys below; paas_driver's own tracked assets/ copies survive, so the already-present guard skips the file copy there).
_comment_asset_keys: Injected into base's AppAssets between the @sdk-asset-keys markers (orders_sdk mechanism); the files themselves arrive via the templates/assets install above. The legacy driver AppAssets paths (assets/image, assets/svg - singular) are kept verbatim so the composed constants keep pointing at the files paas_driver already bundles.

driver._comment_platform_permissions: The courier tracker (courier_location_service.dart) reads GPS from a WorkManager background isolate, which on Android 10+ requires ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION on top of the fine/coarse pair every host already declares; the iOS side needs the combined Always-and-When-In-Use usage string for the same flow. Injected into the host platform files by update_platform_permissions(); driver-only via this flavor block.

ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is shared with dispatch while you are online so orders can be routed to you, including while the app is in the background.

routes._comment: Path, route name and CupertinoRoute type match paas_driver's host-owned entry outside the generated markers, so host navigation call-sites keep working when the host deletes its manual entry + its own copy of the page (M2). The installed page carries @RoutePage(name auto-derived: HomeRoute); SDK lib/ pages never get a generated route class, which is why every routed page here is an installed template.

boot_hooks._comment: Guarded like comms' firebase-fcm boot hook (platform allowlist + fail-open try/catch): workmanager only has Android/iOS implementations, so on a composed Windows exe the old unguarded 'await Workmanager().initialize(...)' threw 'No implementation found for workmanager on this platform' inside main() BEFORE runApp - the driver desktop build died before its first frame (window never shown). The allowlist mirrors the hms hook's capability-narrowed platform set; desktop/web now skip the courier background tracker entirely, which they never supported anyway.

driver._comment_boot_hooks: Driver migration M4 - the last two host-owned startup lines from paas_driver's retired hand-written main.dart. Splash preserve: the home SDK holds the native splash until the router decides where to go (mirrors merchants-manager-splash-preserve, order 1). Workmanager: callbackDispatcher (the periodic courier-location report) is delivery_sdk package code (src/driver/infrastructure/services/courier_location_service.dart, vm:entry-point) because Workmanager invokes it by entry-point reference in a separate isolate - a host-private function could never be referenced from an injected hook body; the installed home page registers/cancels the task by its fetchBackground id from the same file.

app_routes._comment: base_sdk's logged-in splash path (AppHelpers.goHome) calls AppRoutes.I.replaceMainRoute; nothing else in a driver compose declares it, so without this entry a logged-in cold start throws via _HostAppRoutes.noSuchMethod. The driver 'main' is the courier home map (/home, HomeRoute) - same pattern as launch_sdk's LauncherHomeRoute declaration.

_comment_home: delivery_sdk is the driver composition's home SDK (home_sdk flag is what sdk_installer_base.resolve_home_sdk() reads; the composer entry in driver.json should carry the same flag). home_page points at the courier home-map shell template - the key the manifest already named before 1.3.0 without shipping the file; the template now exists and /home is a declared route.
_comment_app_type: driver: paas_driver's courier vertical (S-D3 of the driver lib-regenerable plan). Application layer, the courier orders/parcel facades + Laravel deliveryman repositories (decision D2: moved AS-IS, no Frappe port - endpoints stay /api/v1/dashboard/deliveryman/*), the vehicle slice and the courier profile slices live in lib/src/driver/ - declaring this driver block also keeps that folder alive through sdk_composer.py's strip_unused_role_folders. Templates install to the EXACT paths paas_driver's tracked router/pages import today, so the hash guard skips them while the host copies exist and the recompose after the host deletions (M2/M3) takes over seamlessly; until then the declared routes duplicate the host router's manual entries outside the generated markers (same path + same route class, first match wins - the manual entries drop in M2). The driver host must call DriverDeliveryDependencies.register(GetIt.instance) via direct src/ import (lib/src/driver/di/driver_delivery_di.dart) before the courier pages first build; drawRepository/galleryRepository/userRepository resolve against base_sdk facades registered by map_sdk/products_sdk/users_sdk (all part of driver.json's compose). filter_screen.dart imports revenue_sdk's src/driver statistics provider - the slice S-D2 moves to corporate revenue_sdk; that template only starts installing once the host copy is deleted (M2), which the plan orders after S-D2 lands. courier_statistics_provider.dart is the host-composition seam to revenue_sdk's CourierStatisticsRepositoryFacade (SDK src imports base_sdk only - the profile/home earnings block reads this installed provider instead). restaurant_item/product_item/maps_list live here per decision D3 (single-consumer components live in the consuming SDK; driver.json's products_sdk annotation should be updated). Profile application slices stay courier-owned per decision D4 - they were diffed against base_sdk's profile/edit_profile/setting slices and are NOT identical (password + updateGeneralInfo endpoint + vehicle entanglement), so nothing base-identical is duplicated: generic reads go through base facades (UserRepositoryFacade/GalleryRepositoryFacade) and only courier extras stay. custom_toggle/custom_date_picker/filter_screen/shop_avarat/buttons_bouncing_effect/keyboard_disable/underline_bordered_text_field are custodianship copies: driver-only widgets whose base_sdk same-name twins have incompatible APIs (or no twin), used only by this vertical's templates - installed to the singular lib/presentation/component/ paths the existing driver code imports, so no template rewrites are needed. Templates additionally need host deps the driver pubspec already carries: workmanager, map_launcher, percent_indicator, flutter_rating_bar, google_sign_in, auto_size_text, cached_network_image, url_launcher, lottie, intl_phone_field, flutter_advanced_switch, calendar_date_picker2, shimmer, google_fonts, firebase_messaging, geolocator. Requires .rokct/config/app_type = driver. Version bumped 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0 so version-aware cache reconciliation re-extracts composed copies.
_comment_session_policy: Driver flavour of merchants_sdk's manager policy, per the plan's decision D1 RECOMMENDATION (pending Ray + auth_sdk S-D4): couriers land on /home; any other authenticated role keeps its session and lands on /become-driver to file a courier request (the legacy behaviour - login_notifier.dart gated role != 'deliveryman' to BecomeDriver WITHOUT dropping the token). The '*' fallback entry only takes effect once auth_sdk supports it (S-D4); until then a non-courier is rejected to /become-driver via rejection_route, losing the session - the one behavioural delta, closed by S-D4. Inert today regardless: driver composes auth_sdk with skip_install, so the session-policy shell is absent until the M3 auth flip.
_comment_registration_steps: Injects the courier vehicle-details capture into auth_sdk's post-register pipeline (merchants.shop_setup precedent; see sdk_installer_base.py update_registration_steps()). Fields are EXACTLY the host become_driver form's (decision D5: type_of_technique benzine/diesel/gas/motorbike/bike/foot, brand, model, state number, color, height/width/length/weight, car photo - no new document uploads). Wiring: VehicleDetailsSlide (SDK-owned, lib/src/driver/presentation/widgets/) -> CourierVehicleCapture (consumer-owned interface, ADR-005) -> CourierVehicleDetailsAdapter in the installed delivery_adapters.dart (host composition code) -> GalleryRepositoryFacade.uploadImage + CourierRepositoryFacade.createCarInfo -> POST /api/v1/dashboard/user/request-models. skippable stays default-true and the adapter never throws - a failed or skipped submit must never trap a fresh account; the profile page's edit-car modal offers the details again. NOTE: driver.json currently composes auth_sdk with skip_install, so update_registration_steps() no-ops - this declaration is forward-compatible and comes alive at the M3 flip.
_comment_tr_keys: Courier keys absent from base_sdk's hand-written TrKeys (checked against core main), values verbatim from paas_driver's lib/infrastructure/services/tr_keys.dart - including the legacy 'restauran_home' typo the translation store already contains. The vehicle-step keys (becomeDriver, typeTechnique, benzine..foot, carBrand, carModels, stateNumber, height/width/length/kg, carPicture) already exist in base and are deliberately NOT redeclared (the installer skips base-owned collisions).
